title: AIR: Adaptive Interleaved Reasoning with Code in MLLMs
title_zh: AIR：在 MLLMs 中通过代码实现自适应交错推理
abstract_en: Following the paradigm shift initiated by OpenAI o3, interleaved reasoning with code to enhance multimodal large language models (MLLMs) has become a pivotal research frontier. The existing literature focuses primarily on tool-use within vision-perception tasks. However, such approaches typically rely on predefined heuristics for visual manipulation and are inherently incapable of addressing numerical computation problems due to their exclusive focus on visual operations. This paper empowers MLLMs with adaptive interleaved reasoning capabilities through extended reinforcement learning training on code-augmented complex numerical computation tasks. To this end, we propose a comprehensive three-component solution consisting of: a two-stage cold-start data construction pipeline, data filtering strategies for RL dataset curation, and an adaptive tool-invocation strategy leveraging a group-constrained reward function for interleaved reasoning trajectories. Extensive experiments demonstrate that after Reinforcement Learning training with the group-constrained reward function, performance improves by an average of 6.1 percentage points (pp) on evaluation benchmarks. Specifically, the accuracy for interleaved reasoning samples increases by 9.9 pp, and the overall success rate of tool-use exceeds 95%. Our data and code are available at: https://github.com/CongHan0808/AIR.git.
abstract_zh: 受 OpenAI o3 所开启范式转变的影响，借助代码进行交错推理以增强 multimodal large language models（MLLMs）已成为重要研究方向。现有工作多聚焦于视觉感知任务中的工具使用，通常依赖预定义启发式视觉操作，且由于主要处理视觉变换，难以解决复杂数值计算问题。本文提出 AIR，通过在代码增强的复杂数值计算任务上进行扩展 Reinforcement Learning 训练，使 MLLMs 获得自适应交错推理能力。方法包含三部分：两阶段 cold-start 数据构建流程、用于 RL 数据集筛选的数据过滤策略，以及基于 group-constrained reward function 的自适应工具调用策略，用于优化交错推理轨迹。实验表明，采用该奖励函数进行 RL 训练后，多个评测基准平均性能提升 6.1 个百分点；其中交错推理样本准确率提升 9.9 个百分点，整体工具使用成功率超过 95%。
key_points_zh: 提出 AIR，使 MLLMs 能在复杂数值计算任务中自适应地交错进行自然语言推理与代码执行。
区别于以视觉操作为主的工具使用方法，AIR 面向数值计算问题，缓解预定义视觉启发式规则的局限。
设计两阶段 cold-start 数据构建流程，并结合数据过滤策略，构建更适合 Reinforcement Learning 的训练数据。
提出 group-constrained reward function，引导模型学习何时调用工具以及如何组织交错推理轨迹。
实验显示平均性能提升 6.1 pp，交错推理样本准确率提升 9.9 pp，工具使用成功率超过 95%。

llm_assessment.comment: Technically interesting tool-use RL for multimodal reasoning, but its contribution is mostly model training for a task class rather than reusable agent harness infrastructure.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 这是有技术趣味的多模态工具使用强化学习，但主要贡献是特定任务的模型训练，而非可复用智能体框架基础设施。
